Claim 13 (Currently amended): A flexible respiratory gas tube arrangement for supplying a respiratory gas to a person, the tube arrangement comprising: a flexible tube; a heater to heat the gas as it is delivered through the tube; a first connector provided to one end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a breathing mask; and a second connector provided to the other end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a CPAP device, said second connector including a first portion that provides a respiratory gas passage and a second portion that provides __integrated contact elements positioned externally and extending outwardly from the first portion__ by which power is supplied to said heater, wherein said contact elements are adapted to be engaged with a power supply provided on the CPAP device for supplying power to said heater.

Claim 14 (Previously presented): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, further comprising an insulating sheathing body.

Claim 15 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the insulating sheathing body is removably attachable to the flexible tube __and does not integrate the heater__.

Claim 16 (Cancelled): 

Claim 17 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the insulating sheathing body includes a multi-layered design __with at least one layer providing thermal insulation__.

Claim 18 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the tube is a heatable respiratory gas tube __with heating elements embedded within the tube material__.

Claim 19 (Cancelled):

Claim 20 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein said second connector further includes __a separate__ pressure measuring tube connection.

Claim 21 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, further comprising __an optional__ respiratory gas humidifier __positioned upstream of the breathing mask__.

Claim 22 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 21, wherein said humidifier is adapted to be connected to a water source via a humidification line __independent of the tube arrangement__.

Claim 23 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 21, wherein said humidifier is in the form of a flexible tube piece disposed between the breathing mask and the respiratory gas tube __and is removably attachable__.

Claim 24 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the flexible tube is made from a spirally reinforced plastic material __with a wall thickness of at least 2 millimeters__.

Claim 25 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the heater is an electrical resistance heater __with a power rating between 10 and 50 watts__.

Claim 26 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein each contact element extends generally parallel to a longitudinal axis of the gas passage __and is positioned on the second portion extending outwardly from the first portion__ such that both an electric and pneumatic connection is provided when the connector is connected to the CPAP device.

Claim 27 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein each __contact element__ is provided within the second portion.

Claim 28 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the first portion is tubular and the second portion __is a distinct structural element that__ extends outwardly from the first portion.

Claim 29 (Currently amended): A connector for connecting a CPAP device to a respiratory gas tube arrangement for supplying a respiratory gas to a person, the respiratory gas tube arrangement including a heater, the connector comprising: a first portion that provides a respiratory gas passage; and a second portion that provides __integrated contact elements positioned externally and extending outwardly from the first portion__ by which power is supplied to the heater, wherein each contact element extends generally parallel to a longitudinal axis of the gas passage such that both an electric and pneumatic connection is provided when the connector is connected to the CPAP device.

Claim 30 (Currently amended): A connector according to claim 29, wherein each __contact element__ is provided within the second portion.

Claim 31 (Currently amended): A connector according to claim 29, wherein the first portion is tubular and the second portion __is a distinct structural element that__ extends outwardly from the first portion.
